title: Streaming & TV Addiction
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from streaming and television
addiction. Recovery is a journey of reclaiming your time, attention, energy, and purpose. While
entertainment can be a healthy part of life, healing involves creating a balanced relationship with media
and intentionally investing in your personal growth, relationships, physical well-being, and meaningful
experiences. These affirmations encourage mindfulness, self-discipline, emotional resilience, and
intentional living. They are intended to complement healthy lifestyle practices, counseling when
appropriate, and support from trusted family and friends.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Watching television and streaming content can be enjoyable and enriching when kept in balance. If
excessive viewing is affecting your relationships, work, studies, sleep, physical health, or emotional
well-being, establishing healthy viewing limits and seeking support from a mental health
professional or accountability partner can help. Recovery is not about eliminating entertainment-it
is about ensuring that your life is guided by your values, goals, and relationships rather than by

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I recognize when entertainment is serving me and when it is distracting me.
I choose intentional viewing instead of automatic binge-watching.
Every healthy decision strengthens my self-control.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Compassion
focus: I reconnect with myself through meaningful experiences.
I embrace quiet moments without needing constant entertainment.
I choose presence over passive distraction.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I create healthy boundaries around my screen time.
I invest my time in activities that help me grow.
My confidence increases every time I choose purpose over habit.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: Entertainment has a healthy place in my life but does not define it.
I create a balanced lifestyle filled with learning, connection, creativity, and joy.
I embrace a future guided by intention, mindfulness, and meaningful living.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by the amount of entertainment I consume but by the life I choose to create. Every
day I choose balance, I reclaim my time, strengthen my focus, deepen my relationships, and invest in
my dreams. One intentional choice, one meaningful moment, and one day at a time, I am creating a
life filled with purpose, freedom, joy, and lasting fulfillment.
